authority: Incidental measurement produced by the pre-train audit of 4V4_B3_SPECIALIZATION_PRESERVING_SPEC.json (experiments/verify_sibling_sep_pretrain.py, property P4). Reported to the PI immediately because it bears on the premise of that SPEC.
WHAT_WAS_MEASURED: Jensen-Shannon divergence between the action distributions of the two FROZEN vanilla B3 specialists, evaluated on the frozen GUARD/BREACH disagreement state set, restricted to decision-eligible agent-heads.

METHOD.state_provenance: 64 episodes on collection seeds 16810001-16810064 (32 Pole A + 32 Pole B3), states retained ONLY where projected scripted GUARD (BLUE_ONE_DEFENDER_V2) and BREACH (BLUE_BOTH_ATTACK_V2) discrete actions disagree on at least one decision-eligible agent

READING: On the very states where the scripted strategic contrast is defined, the two vanilla specialists are NOT behaviorally identical at the policy-distribution level: they sit at roughly half of the maximum attainable JSD. Combined with the flat sealed payoff matrix (all four cells ~0.67-0.72), this points at 'behaviorally distinct but not payoff-specialized' rather than 'collapsed into one policy family'.
LIMITS_OF_THIS_MEASUREMENT: per-state action-distribution divergence, NOT closed-loop behavior: differences may wash out over trajectories and produce identical macro outcomes
states were generated by a scripted driver, so this is an off-policy state distribution relative to either specialist's own rollouts
decision-eligible heads only; says nothing about committed steps
does not establish that the differing actions are STRATEGICALLY meaningful (defender allocation, penetration, flag pressure) rather than local/cosmetic
single batch of 64 rows; no confidence interval was computed
CONSEQUENCE: PI, 2026-09-10: sibling-separation training is NOT launched. 4V4_B3_SPECIALIZATION_PRESERVING_SPEC.json is placed on HOLD pending a closed-loop behavior/role capture on the same frozen vanilla pair, because the SPEC's premise (homogenization) is weakened by this measurement. See 4V4_B3_SPECIALIZATION_PRESERVING_HOLD.json.
SEEDS_SPENT_BY_THIS_MEASUREMENT: none beyond the already-consumed collection block 16810001-16810064; no training seed, no dev block, no sealed crossover seed
